title: Execute MVP exit qualification audits on Argus and Mnemosyne
description: Execute and verify complete end-to-end self-audit on Argus and multi-crate audit on Mnemosyne, confirming coverage balancing, interruption recovery, and compliance with documentation, correctness, and architecture quality thresholds.

title: Phase 12: End-to-End Hardening and MVP Exit
description: Complete hardening, operational resilience, observability, CI gate exit policies, and qualification runs across Argus and Mnemosyne to satisfy MVP exit criteria.

title: Implement non-interactive CI exit policies and automated gate enforcement
description: Add non-interactive --ci execution mode for argus audit and argus evaluate that enforces configured quality thresholds, returning non-zero exit codes on threshold failure without blocking on human adjudication.

title: Report finalization and bundle export with unadjudicated findings
description: Ensure argus finalize cleanly demarcates unadjudicated candidate findings from corroborated, disputed, and rejected findings, sealing portable bundles with content-addressed manifests before human adjudication is completed.

title: Enhance audit progress, health, cost, and stall observability
description: Enhance argus status and logging to report queue throughput, monotonic completion range, projected completion time, token usage, estimated provider cost, disk usage growth, and detection/warning for stalled or deadlocked work items.

title: Implement long-duration soak testing, lease maintenance, and fault injection
description: Build automated soak and stress tests that simulate multi-day/multi-week audit runs under provider throttling/rate limits, worker crashes, redb storage growth, and lease renewal heartbeats to prove memory stability and queue progress.

title: Implement graceful shutdown, signal handling, and restart recovery validation
description: Implement SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers that flush pending redb transactions and cleanly release in-flight work leases. Add integration tests verifying that interrupted audits resume without duplicate effective outcomes or state corruption.

title: Implement full pipeline presets for local and CI execution
description: Implement unified pipeline presets (argus audit --pipeline full) coordinating execution across documentation, correctness, and architecture review policies with distinct configuration profiles for interactive local developers vs automated CI runners.

title: Calibrate quality thresholds and complete human adjudication for code-derived architecture review
description: Adjudicate seeded architecture runs against docs/evaluation/architecture-corpus-v1.json using argus adjudicate, configure baseline quality thresholds in docs/architecture-evaluation.md, and confirm that reporting explains meaningful cross-crate structure and seeded structural defects to satisfy Phase 11 exit gate.

title: Calibrate quality thresholds and complete human adjudication for correctness review
description: Adjudicate seeded correctness runs against docs/evaluation/correctness-corpus-v1.json using argus adjudicate, configure baseline precision, recall, and stability thresholds in docs/evaluation/correctness-thresholds-v1.json, and record threshold validation in docs/correctness-evaluation.md to satisfy Phase 10 exit gate.

title: Calibrate quality thresholds and complete human adjudication for documentation review
description: Adjudicate seeded documentation runs against docs/evaluation/documentation-corpus-v1.json using argus adjudicate, set baseline precision, recall, duplicate rate, and unable-to-verify thresholds in docs/evaluation/documentation-thresholds-v1.json, and record threshold validation in docs/documentation-evaluation.md to satisfy Phase 9 exit gate.

title: Address documentation audit findings on Argus public APIs
description: Add comprehensive Rust doc comments with purpose, behavior, invariants, and examples to core public APIs identified in argus_review.md (DurableQueue, ActorRegistry, AdapterRegistry, CaptureOptions, etc.).

title: Provide precise source locations and targets in report finding clusters
description: Replace opaque Cluster hash with source location, line numbers, and target IDs in DocumentationReport, CorrectnessReport, and ArchitectureReport markdown renderings.

title: Evaluate correctness and documentation review models against updated prompt rubrics
description: Run argus evaluate correctness and argus evaluate documentation with active model provider profiles to measure precision, recall, and stability on the newly instructed gap, stub, and TODO enforcement rules, tuning adjudication thresholds accordingly.

title: Add seeded documentation corpus cases for gaps/stubs missing TODO comments
description: Expand docs/evaluation/documentation-corpus-v1.json and its workspace to include targets where gaps, inconsistencies, stubs, or unimplemented aspects are documented without TODO markers, verifying that documentation analysis flags them as defects.

title: Add seeded correctness corpus cases for documented stubs and scope gaps
description: Expand docs/evaluation/correctness-corpus-v1.json and its workspace to include targets with documented stubs (e.g., todo!(), unimplemented!(), dummy returns) and scope-implied gaps, verifying that evaluation harnesses detect and surface them as candidate findings even when documented.

title: Phase 15: Incremental and CI-Lite Review
description: Implement target and dependency content fingerprints, cache invalidation graphs, cached review assessments, changed-target impact analysis, and baseline comparison for fast PR/CI reviews.

title: Phase 13: Second Source-Language Adapter (Python or TypeScript)
description: Implement a second source-language adapter (Python or TypeScript) to validate multi-adapter repository discovery, partial semantic capabilities, dynamic dispatch, and foreign package managers.

title: Author operator documentation and troubleshooting runbooks
description: Author operator and developer documentation covering repository onboarding (argus init, argus prime), provider profile configuration, long-running audit management, crash recovery, and threshold tuning.

title: Implement retention, compaction, and intermediate state cleanup controls
description: Implement retention and cleanup CLI commands to safely prune intermediate evidence blobs, cached architecture graph data, and redundant model transcripts while preserving finalized audit bundles and historical adjudications.

title: Update evaluation and policy documentation for correctness gaps and documentation TODO rules
description: Update docs/correctness-evaluation.md, docs/documentation-evaluation.md, and relevant architecture docs to document the rubric rules covering gaps, stubs, documented defect non-exemption, and the TODO requirement in comments.

title: Support surfacing documented gap findings into backlog and top-level documentation
description: Implement workflow / CLI support to export or convert surfaced candidate findings representing documented future work, stubs, and scope gaps directly into project backlog tasks or top-level documentation tracking.

title: Phase 17: Extended Reports, MCP Server Parity, and Publishing
description: Implement rich HTML report export, SARIF output for static analysis integration, full Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lifecycle tools, and durable GitHub / Beads issue publication with cryptographic publication receipts.

title: Phase 16: Maintainability and Performance Review Policies
description: Implement MaintainabilityReviewPolicy (complexity, coupling, duplication) and PerformanceReviewPolicy (allocations, contention, I/O, async blocking, benchmark/profiling evidence) with dedicated rubrics and evaluation corpora.

title: Phase 14: Design Documents and Conformance Policy
description: Index ADRs, PRDs, and engineering design documents; link design artifacts to review targets and architectural regions; evaluate conformance between declared intent and observed code implementation.
